# couchbase-capella-aidp_model (Resource)

Manages a Capella-hosted AI model deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella-aidp_model" "embed" {
  organization_id    = var.organization_id
  name               = "my-embedding-model"
  catalog_model_name = "nvidia/llama-3.2-nv-embedqa-1b-v2"

  cloud_config = {
    provider = "aws"
    region   = "us-east-1"
    compute = {
      cpu        = 4
      gpu_memory = 24
    }
  }
}

resource "couchbase-capella-aidp_model" "llm" {
  organization_id    = var.organization_id
  name               = "my-text-generation-model"
  catalog_model_name = "mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3"

  cloud_config = {
    provider = "aws"
    region   = "us-east-1"
    compute = {
      cpu        = 4
      gpu_memory = 48
    }
  }

  caching = jsonencode({
    enableStandard       = true
    enableConversational = true
    semantic = {
      embeddingModel = couchbase-capella-aidp_model.embed.name
      scoreThreshold = 0.75
      dimensions     = 2048
      distanceMetric = "dot_product"
    }
    defaultCache = "semantic"
    expiryTTL    = 4000
  })

  depends_on = [couchbase-capella-aidp_model.embed]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_model_name` (String)
- `cloud_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_config))
- `name` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)

### Optional

- `caching` (String) JSON caching configuration. For semantic caching, `semantic.embeddingModel` must be the deployed embedding model's **name** (not id).
- `dimensions` (Number)
- `enable_batching` (Boolean)
- `guardrails` (List of String)
- `jailbreak` (String)
- `keyword_filtering` (List of String)
- `optimization` (String) Optimization profile: `throughput` or `latency`.
- `quantization` (String) Quantization option. Capella accepts: `int4`, `int8`, `int16`, `fp16`, `fp32`, `fp64`, or `bf16`.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data for the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `config` (String)
- `connection_string` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
